purpose: Granular milestone truth beneath the strategic Phase A-F roadmap. This is the only machine-readable milestone register. Future milestone IDs may be refined by Manager only by updating this file; strategic phases are not deleted.

strategicRoadmap.rule: Phase A-F remains the strategic roadmap. This register adds implementation-sized milestones and does not replace the phases.

sequence: verify each agent branch and focused evidence
reconcile backend contract and frontend consumption
classify mechanical, contract, architecture and scope conflicts
run shared alignment and full relevant gates
validate merge candidate against protected main
mergeProtocol.completionRule: An agent branch can be complete without the milestone being complete. P2.13 becomes complete only on reconciled, verified protected main.

milestones.title: Skill
deliverables: four published operations: skill.list, skill.resolve, skill.describe, skill.validate-selection
milestones.implementationBoundary: Skill registration, discovery, validation and lifecycle. No Skill procedure execution, no Agent Machine, no Memory store, no provider/runtime integration.

milestones.title: Context & Session
deliverables: backend tests and frontend contract consumption
milestones.implementationBoundary: Context/session lifecycle, snapshots, references, compaction bookkeeping, checksum lineage, rollover, continuation serialization, rehydration, verification, bounded local state and presentation. Context is not Conversation, Session is not Context Window, Memory is not Context, and Execution is not implemented here.
decisionDependencies: no new XA row for implementation drift
Manager reconciliation PASS and MERGE PASS are required
completionCriteria: one Context & Session LEGO with no duplicate domain
locked contracts and exact frontend/backend vocabulary
context/session lifecycle and fail-closed invalid transitions
frontend shows explicit continuation/degraded/failure states without fabricated tokens

finishEvidence.role: not complete until protected-main merge and post-merge verification

reconciliation.affected: ai.context, ai.agent-session, Context & Session frontend vocabulary, operation matrix, publication metadata, generated milestone state
reconciliation.conflict: Agent 1 consumes Context & Session as declared-not-locked and treats rollover, rehydrate and verify as unpublished; Agent 2 publishes both 1.0.0 lock rows and declares those three context operations public. This is a contract/governance conflict, not a mechanical merge conflict.
reconciliation.contract: ai.context@1.0.0 and ai.agent-session@1.0.0 differ between the branches in publication status and, for ai.context, the public operation set. Agent 1 quotes context operations load/compact and pending publication; Agent 2 locks context operations load/compact/rollover/rehydrate/verify and session operations create/status/close.
reconciliation.evidence: Agent 1 commit 6a217227dd5a4ff3f8e4f350db0422937cd8fccf / Draft PR #46; Agent 2 commit fb254f3222010db481e82f156208359c53f5840a / Draft PR #45; protected baseline e754c5df35b41b0ff2ac769519f05f056835411c.
reconciliation.agent1Interpretation: The protected baseline has 15 lock rows and no ai.context or ai.agent-session rows. The frontend must report declared-not-locked, render no published version, quote load/compact plus session create/status/close, and keep rollover/rehydrate/verify pending under XA-20.
reconciliation.agent2Interpretation: P2.13 adds two additive 1.0.0 rows under ai-foundation. The backend implementation and lock publish ai.context load/compact/rollover/rehydrate/verify with ai:context:read/write, and ai.agent-session create/status/close with the three declared agent permissions.
reconciliation.reason: The peer branch became remotely visible after the original blocked record. Cross-agent execution against Agent 2 backend files now fails on five alignment/publication assertions: contextOperation adds rollover/rehydrate/verify; baseline lock absence assumptions fail; publication metadata remains declared-not-locked; and the full view reports drift.
reconciliation.requiredDecision: Manager must resolve XA-20: whether the two rows are published in P2.13 and exactly which rollover, continuation, verification operations and permissions are public. Neither agent may silently choose the larger operation set or preserve the baseline pending interpretation.
